Section 10 has no hole size reported (source unknown); it ran from 2008-06-05 to 2008-06-08 at 2788.0 m measured depth with no new hole and no rate.
Section 11 is the 12.25 in hole on 2008-06-09 at 2788.0 m measured depth; it drilled no new hole, so no drilling rate is given.

On 2007-11-08, a weather wait of 12.0 h held up the conductor work.
On 2007-12-04, an ROV manipulator claw was lost in the hole while the 26.0 in bit run was being prepared.

On 2007-12-05, junk was found trapped in the roller cones of the 26.0 in bit on pulling out, and a upper BHA sub sleeve that had not been fastened correctly led to a 5.0 h primary repair in section 3.
On 2008-05-20, top drive alignment repairs added 10.75 h of possible (not primary) lost time.
On 2008-05-22, the MWD signal fault led to a 0.5 h primary repair, and drilling of the 12.25 in section continued at limited rate for 9.5 h while the MWD signal was decoded.
On 2008-05-27, attempts to set a lock-down sub in the casing hanger failed over 3.0 h of operations.
On 2008-06-01, the riser landing guide funnel hinge had to be cut to free the funnel over a 6.25 h operation, and production start-up followed the same day.

Sections 18 (workover, 2008-07-03 to 2008-07-10) and 19 (workover, 2009-03-06 to 2009-03-13) carry long non-drilling periods: section 18 had 26.5 h of primary and 29.5 h of possible lost time, and section 19 had 80.0 h of possible wait time.
Section 20 (workover, 2010-09-10 to 2010-09-20) carried 56.0 h of primary lost time from rig up and rig down and weather waits.
On 2016-07-31, the plug-and-abandonment started with several waits on cement totalling 12.0 h of possible lost time, while the BOP and the forward PRS were maintained.
On 2016-08-10, a casing fish at the wellhead stump hung up through the hanger, and the spear work that followed was recorded as a 3.25 h primary repair.
On 2016-08-11, the fish was released from the spear after 0.75 h, which is recorded as primary repair time.
On 2016-08-12, the flow check recorded that the well was not static, with the report stating Losses of 10,5m3/hour, and the lost circulation totals 12.75 h of primary lost time for the wellbore.
Build weather contingency into the conductor and the first hole running plan: weather waits are the largest primary cause at 141.0 h, and on 2007-11-12 a 15.5 h weather wait held the conductor work.
Check that downhole tools are correctly fastened and function-tested before running the 26.0 in BHA: on 2007-12-05 a sleeve not fastened correctly cost a 5.0 h primary repair in section 3.
Carry a spare MWD signal path for the 12.25 in section: the MWD signal fault on 2008-05-22 cost a 0.5 h repair and 9.5 h of drilling at limited rate.
Rehearse the wellhead running and lock-down sub sequence before the hanger work: attempts on 2008-05-27 failed over 3.0 h of operations.
Inspect riser landing and guide-funnel hinges before the riser run: on 2008-06-01 a hinge had to be cut, a 6.25 h operation.

For abandonment work, plan for fish retrieval and losses: the casing fish cost a 3.25 h primary repair on 2016-08-10 and losses were recorded on 2016-08-12, with lost circulation at 12.75 h of primary lost time.
Keep workover waits down: the 2009 workover section carried 80.0 h of possible waits, which are not primary lost time but still consumed rig time.

row.comments: WOW, due to high wind and waves. Wind 50-87 knop.

Laid down top single at 190 m. Made up the cement stand. Washed down with the conductor to approx 40 cm above TD, 1000 lpm. Took digiquartz measurements. RIH and set conductor at TD 196.8 m. Confirmed top of housing 43 cm lower than F-7.
WOW for visibility to improve on template. Unable to engage hot-stab for centraliser rams. Damaged claw for ROV arm. Came to surface with ROV to repare claw, dived again with ROV.

Held toolbox talk prior to making up 26" drilling BHA. Removed masterbushing and ran 26" Bit / gMWD assy through rotary. Inserted gMWD probe in BHA as per Scientific instructions. Meanwhile ROV attempted to connect hose to CTS funnel. CTS hose was too short and the funnel had to be turned. ROV lost 3-finger claw when attempteing to turn CTS funnel.

Established drilling parameters. Drilled 26" hole section from 206 m to 211 m MD. Drilling parameters : Flow 3100 lpm / SPP 62 bar / 1-2 MT WOB / Rotation 125 RPM / String torque 1-3 kNm. Pumped 20 m3 hi-vis to clean the hole at 211 m MD. Scientifc drilling reported that UBHO sleeve had not been fastened correctly in the carrier. Decided to pull BHA for remedial action.
Continued working on TDS allignment cylinder.
Continued working on TDS allignment cylinder. Picked up single and installed in rotary for making final allignment on TDS.
Parked TDS for service. Worked on TDS allignment cylinder. Meanwhile pressure tested valves in kill and choke manifolds to 35/345 bar 5/10 min.

Drilled 12 1/4" hole section from 2299 m to 2460 m MD. Drilling parameters : Flow 3500 lpm / SPP 232-238 bar / String RPM 120-140 / Bit RPM 220-240 / WOB 3-8 MT / Torque 6-13 kNm / ECD 1,32 /  Drilled with limited ROP 20-30 m/hr due to problems with MWD sinal decoding.
Trouble-shoot MWD signal. Meanwhile drilled ahead 1 m of 12 1/4" hole.

1) Performed line test from cmt unit to HCR valve, 30/220 bar 5/10 min. Ok.
2) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed top pipe ram. No go.
3) Checked for possible leaks in toolstring by opening IBOP and monitor gain in trip tank. No leak observed.
4) Pressured up to set lock down sub against closed btm pipe ram. No go.
5) Pulled lock down sub 1 m above landing no go. Flushed wellhead with 1100 lpm / 15 min.  Landed lock down sub and made 4 1/4 turns CW, torque 1700 Nm with neutral weight. Toolstring dropped 8 inches. Attempted to set lock down sub. No go.

Re-arranged lifting slings on RLGF and put tension on wires. Attempted to unlock guide funnel hinge using ROV. No sucess. Fetched crow bar from surface and attempted to bend guide funnel hinge. No sucess. Fetched cutting device from surface and cut guide funnel hinge with tension on RLGF wire slings. RLGF came free. Lowered PR a fraction. Attempted to move RLGF but found that riser weight had landed off on funnel edge. PU PR a fraction and moved landing guide funnel to seabed aft of F-10/F-15. Alligned TBC ROV panel, landed TBC and applied 15 mT.

Pumped baseoil to cmt unit and verified line-up to F-12. Performed line test 30 /150 bar 5/10 min against F-12 wing valve. Pumped 8.5 m3 baseoil to pressure up and equalized above DHSV. Opened F-12 DHSV at 93 bar. Displaced cmt unit and kill line to SW.

Launched hotstab on mini-reel hose down to seabed, attached to guidewire. Removed dummy hot stab and installed hydraulic hot stab into receptacle at top of TBC using ROV.

Production started at 23:25.

WOC.
Closed SV and bled off pressure on cement unit and surface lines.
Monitored pressure in XT cross from prod. control room.
Meanwhile: Flushed lines from cement unit. Performed maintenance on BOP. Prepared to change out wires on FWD PRS.

Bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 55 bar at 02:00.

WOC
Continued performing maintenance on BOP and FWD PRS.

Bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 56 bar at 03:45
Bled off pressure in XT cross from 100 bar to 54 bar at 06:10

WOC
Continued maintenance on BOP and FWD PRS.
Tested kill manifold to 20/310bar for 5/10min.

Bled off pressure in XT cross from 97 bar to 55 bar at 10:40.

Pulled free of fish, hung up with grapple at 139.4m through hanger. Troubleshoot to get through. 
Attempted to pull with max 10 ton overpull - no success. 
Pulled up slowly and rotate to the right - no success. Tried to rotate to the left and pull - no success.  
Pulled and pumped with 200l/min - 4 bar, pressure increased to 30bar when took weight at 139.4m. 
RIH and engaged spear inside 10 3/4in csg, pulled same through the hanger - ok. 
Rotated it 4.5 turns to the left (2-3k torq) to reposition casing fish inside the well. Landed fish in the well and released spear. 
Attempted to pull spear through hanger - no success. Pulled up total of 3,4m from top of csg stump at 141.9m
Released fish. Pulled gradually to 170t weight on hook (65t overpull). Observed drop on hook load to 103t indicating string free.
Flow checked well on trip tank. Well not static. Losses of 10,5m3/hour
